en: I'm working hard to find a way to make them.
note: Follows #7919 (slice 098), which must be a noun phrase such as 'Romantic, elegant dresses at lower prices...'.

en: Curtains, dresses...
I'd love to design beautiful patterns
that women dream of...
Design work is fun, but
I've been so wrapped up in it that I seem
to have gotten rather old.
I used to be asked, "When will you marry?"
but lately that has turned into
"Why won't you marry?"
The motifs for my designs, you see,
are found in the countryside.
Wildflowers, berries, herbs... all lovely,
and they stir a woman's sense of romance.
Above all, they bring peace to the people
of this filthy city.
Well, back to work.
You know, I have a fiancé back in the country.
But I really wanted to work in design,
so I came to London on my own.
Once I've saved a bit more, I'll go home.
Not that I've given up
on being a designer, mind you.
On the contrary, what I want to design
is out in the country, that's all.
After living in London for a while,
I truly see how good the country is.
Oops, I can't dawdle like this.
My work is really piling up.
What brings you here at this hour...
Well... before you go back to the country,
I just had to see you...
Oh my, you came all this way for that?
I'm sorry.
Roberta, lend me your strength!
Ah, what are you doing?
Eeeeek!
I only need to borrow your strength for a little while.
Not God, but you,
note: Stella (enthralled): 'Not God, but you, {NAME}, my master, / are now the one I serve...'

en: , my master,
are now the one I serve...
Welcome to our church.
I am a nun. My name is Stella.
Come, let us offer our prayers together...
Oh my, is something the matter?
Are you feeling unwell?
No, it's no matter.
It's just that I'm not fond of places
like this...
Oh, it's you...
I see you found your way to the chapel
without getting lost this time.
All things follow God's guidance...
Come, let us pray together...
You're so pale... you don't look well.
I shall pray to God for you...
The rich and the poor...
Many people think there are only these
two kinds of people in the world.
But that is not so.
How foolish are those who seek wealth
and act as their desires dictate.
All that glitters
is not gold.
Hmph. So humans gratefully lap up
talk like this, do they...
Drivel.
I hear that in this city, evil drugs sell
at high prices, and that many people use
them habitually...
But do not rely on such things;
keep God in your hearts, all of you.
Salvation costs no money.
It is given freely...
Hmph. The same old pious sermon,
is it...
But however fine the words you preach,
you are just one more foolish human.
(Hmph. Repeating dull sermons every day...
note: Subject omitted in JP; 'she' (Stella) inferred in #7999.

en: how does she never tire of it...)
